label: About
title: About Atlas Spine Jackpot
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 78 recent saved-signal files and 72 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around VGMaps.com: The Video Game Atlas and Anchor image material 1, plus 7 more. A source image from vgmaps.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Atlas Spine Jackpot: Make a ruptured vertical game-atlas world: game-space surface as architectural section, seen in a violent narrow crop. A pale overexposed spine runs top to bottom between two black rails; stacked rooms, corridors, ladders, and reel-slice wounds cling to the edges. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central pale atlas spine cut, left dark rail with laddered inner edge, and right compressed rail with chamber pockets.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
